data.name: AlAyman
data.gender_notes: AlAyman is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘A-L-Y’, meaning ‘to guard’ or ‘to protect’. AlAyman is a name of strength and protection, often given to boys who are seen as a shield or a guardian for their family. The name AlAyman carries the meaning “Guardian, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlAyman usually hope their child will grow to embody guardian, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of protection and guardianship in the path of Allah.
data.etymology: AlAyman belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlAyman total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الأيمن
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر معناه اليمن والبركة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الأيمن هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني اليمن والبركة، وهو مشتق من كلمة 'يمن' التي تعني البركة والخير. وقد ورد ذكر اليمن في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس، حيث قال تعالى: 'وَجِئْنَاكَ بِالْيَمِينِ' (يس: ٣٦). ويعتبر الأيمن من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني إيجابية وروحانية، حيث يرمز إلى الخير والبركة

in_urdu.name: الایمن
in_urdu.meaning: الایمن ۔ مذکر اسم علم، معنی یمن، برکت
in_urdu.long_meaning: الایمن ایک مذکر اسم علم ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے یمن، برکت، اور خوشحالی۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، جہاں 'یمن' برکت اور خیر کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی روایت میں، یمن کو ایک ایسے ملک کے طور پر ذکر کیا گیا ہے جو برکتوں سے بھرا ہوا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے، جو اسے اپنے بچوں کو برکت اور خوشحالی کی دعا کے طور پر دیتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: अलैमन
in_hindi.meaning: अलैमन । पुल्लिंग नाम, अर्थ यमन, आशीर्वाद
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलैमन एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है यमन, आशीर्वाद और समृद्धि। यह नाम अरबी मूल से निकला है, जहां 'यमन' आशीर्वाद और शुभता को दर्शाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यमन को एक ऐसा देश माना जाता है जो आशीर्वादों से भरा हुआ है। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है, जो इसे अपने बच्चों को आशीर्वाद और समृद्धि की कामना के रूप में देते हैं

in_pashto.name: الايمن
in_pashto.meaning: الايمن سړیږی نوم، معنی یې یمن، برکت
in_pashto.long_meaning: الايمن د سړیږی علم نوم دی چی د عربی ژبی څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم معنی یې یمن، برکت او خوشحالی ده. دا نوم د عربی ريښو څخه راغلی دی، چیرې چې 'یمن' د برکت او خیر ښودنه کوي. د افغانستان په اسلامی روایت کې، یمن داسې یو هېواد دی چی برکتونو څخه ډک دی. دا نوم د پښتنو په منځ کې مشهور دی، دوی دا نوم خپلو بچو ته د برکت او خوشحالی دعا په توګه ورکوي

in_english.name: AlAyman
in_english.meaning: AlAyman means blessings, goodness, and prosperity
in_english.long_meaning: AlAyman is a masculine given name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies blessings, goodness, and prosperity. Etymologically, it stems from the Arabic word 'yamin', which connotes blessings and righteousness. In Islamic tradition, Yemen is referenced as a land filled with blessings. The name AlAyman carries spiritual significance, symbolizing positive attributes such as generosity, compassion, and peace. Across Muslim cultures, it is bestowed upon children to invoke divine blessings and prosperity upon them

data.cultural_impact: The name AlAyman carries a deep cultural importance in the Islamic community, as it reflects the desire for protection and strength in a family unit. In many Middle Eastern and Muslim cultures, the role of a male family member as a protector is highly valued. Children given the name AlAyman are viewed as symbols of this protective role and are expected to live up to this responsibility as they grow older.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name AlAyman also holds great significance as it is reminiscent of Allah's promise to protect and guide His followers. In Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 286 of the Quran, it is stated, "Allah is the guardian of those who believe. He brings them out from their darknesses towards the light, but those who disbelieved, their protectors are taghoot (idols, false deities) whom they invoke." Thus, the name AlAyman is not only a reminder of the cultural importance of protection but also a spiritual reminder of Allah's promise to protect and guide His followers.
